about: Greater Napanee is a town in Lennox and Addington County, Ontario, west of Kingston at the mouth of the Napanee River on the Bay of Quinte approaches. A historic downtown, falls, and amalgamated rural wards make it both a small urban centre and a wider countryside municipality. Highway 401 runs just north of town. About 16,000 people live in Greater Napanee.
